evidence.why_not_priced: If this arithmetic were priced there would be a published FY27 revenue estimate below $240m and a sell-side note on the operating-leverage cliff; instead stockanalysis.com shows 'Analyst Forecast: Not available', the sweep found a single estimate, there is no conference call and no option chain, and the stock trades ~2,000 shares a day (368 shares today). Most tellingly, the 2026-06-23 release that disclosed the single largest backlog drop of the cycle produced only a -3.63% reaction, versus -21.23% and -13.08% on prior, smaller backlog disappointments -- that is not a market that has run the conversion math.
